metadata.description: Daughter of Olwë, king of Alqualondë. A sea-elf (Falmar) of the Teleri. Married Finarfin, son of Finwë, in the year 1280 of the Years of the Trees. Mother of four children: Finrod Felagund, Angrod, Aegnor, and Galadriel. Through her marriage, she connected the Teleri and Noldor houses. Her golden-haired children inherited Vanyarin blood through their grandmother Indis.
